objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed documentation of specific procedures and process sequences with responsible persons

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Description of specific procedures within a framework with process sequence and details

objs.name: document
objs.description: General document object that can be of various types managed in the system

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-critical document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Planned amendment to a document that does not affect content or version history

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: Request to check and extend the validity of a document after a defined period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person with read and write permissions responsible for document creation and content

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with read and write permissions assisting with document creation

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for approving document for distribution to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person responsible for translating released document content to other languages

objs.name: reader
objs.description: Person with read-only access to approved documents

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: User group with read access to archived documents

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Collection of users and user groups assigned to receive document access

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users assigned together for authorization purposes

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach new document object to system with specified document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify document content using office editing client

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Set and update document metadata and attributes

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designate person responsible for document creation

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Designate additional person with document change rights

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designate person to check document content

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designate person to approve document for distribution

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Grant read access to specified users or groups

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Start workflow-supported review step of document release process

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Complete workflow step with electronic signature by authorized person

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approve document for publication and distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document visible to assigned readers

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document to PDF format after saving

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Generate new editing version when released document is revised

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit planned amendment to existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create new document version incorporating change proposal

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Mark change proposal as finished and no longer display in document

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated check of document validity before expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm document validity and update valid until date

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create new version when document needs updates based on validity extension

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Submit request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: Declare document invalid and archive with revoked authorizations

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submit request to re-validate previously invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore invalidated document to valid status with new version

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create language-dependent version of released document

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve translated version for visibility to readers in target language

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to users when new document version released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Request users to actively confirm receipt of document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User workflow-supported confirmation of document receipt without signature

o2e.description: Document is created in system
Document content is modified
Document properties and metadata are set
Author is designated for document
Co-author is designated for document
Reviewer is designated for document
Releaser is designated for document
Reader is assigned access to document
Document is submitted to review workflow
Reviewer checks document content
Author signs document in workflow
Reviewer signs document in workflow
Releaser signs document in workflow
Document is approved for distribution
Document is published for reader access
Document is converted to PDF format
New version of document is created
Attachment is marked for archiving
Change proposal is created for document
Change proposal is incorporated into new document version
Change proposal is marked complete
Validity extension request is created for document
Releaser confirms validity extension
Document is revised based on validity extension
Override request is created for document
Document is declared invalid and archived
Reactivation request is created for document
Document is restored from invalid state
Translator creates language version of document
Reviewer checks translated document
Releaser approves translated document
Email notification sent to distribution list
Acknowledgement request sent to distribution list
Reader confirms receipt of document
